generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. Every module sets tasks, judges them against a standard, and gives you feedback; the students who take charge of that cycle, and run it on purpose, are the ones whose work improves from one task to the next rather than repeating the same mistakes. Treat what follows as being about your own essays, reports and projects, not about study in the abstract.

The same pattern runs through professional practice. You are given a brief, your work is judged against a standard, you receive feedback, and you carry it into the next task. Directing your own learning and improving from feedback is a habit you keep long after you graduate.
